jobs.title: Unarmed Security Officer - (Level II Noncommissioned)
jobs.description:
About First Responder Protective Services


First Responder Protective Services is a premier provider of private security needs across the U.S. Our company is owned, operated and managed by U.S. Military veterans, law enforcement executives, and corporate business professionals. Our founders have over 60 years of experience in protecting critical infrastructures, combating transnational criminal organizations, mitigating risks, and providing the highest level of safety and security to corporations and communities.


The mission of First Responder Protective Services is to provide the highest level of customer service to each and every client. We accomplish this mission through our foundation of attention to detail, integrity, accountability, empathy, care, and concern for the needs of our clients and the officers which we serve.


Job Title: Non-Commissioned Security Guard (Level II)
Location: Grapevine
Pay: $18-$20 per hour, depending on qualifications (paid weekly)
Status: Full-time & Part-time

Position Summary


First Responder Protective Services (FRPS) is hiring multiple FLEX Non-Commissioned Security Guards to provide a consistent security presence at a controlled-access community in the Grapevine area. This position is primarily based in a spacious, climate-controlled guard shack, where officers will manage access control, monitor video surveillance and access systems, and check residents and visitors in and out of the property. The guard shack is equipped with basic necessities and access to clean, private restroom facilities. Officers will also conduct occasional patrols of the property, both on foot and by golf cart, to maintain visibility and ensure the safety of residents and property. Weekday and weekend shifts are available, with 24/7 coverage required.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage check-in/out residents and visitors in a climate controlled shack.
  • Monitor entrances, access points, and surveillance systems.
  • Respond promptly to alarms, emergencies, or incidents.
  • Prepare detailed incident and activity reports as required.
  • Remain alert and proactive in identifying and reporting security concerns
  • Follow all post orders and supervisor instructions
  • Occasional mobile and foot patrol in assigned areas to ensure safety and security of residents, staff, and property.


Requirements

  • Must have at least one year of experience unarmed security.
  • Must hold a current Level II Texas Noncommissioned Security License
  • Must have a valid Texas Driver’s License (or ability to obtain before starting)
  • Professional appearance and demeanor
  • Ability to work independently or with a team
  • Able to sit, stand, or walk for extended periods


Schedule

Full Time position:

  • Sunday: 10p-6a
  • Monday: 10p-6a
  • Tuesday: 10p-6a
  • Wednesday: 10p-6a
  • Thursday: 10p-6a
  • Friday: OFF
  • Saturday: OFF


Part Time position:

  • Saturday 2p-10p
  • Sunday 2p-10p


Uniform & Equipment

  • FRPS Provides: Uniform shirt, hats, cold weather gear
  • Officer Provides: Duty pants, black boots


Compensation & Advancement

  • Hourly Pay: $18-$20/hour (based on experience and availability)
  • Pay Frequency: Bi-weekly via direct deposit
  • Status: W2 employee (eligible for overtime after 40 hours in a workweek)
  • Shifts: 8 hours per day


Full-Time Employee Benefits

  • Paid Time Off (PTO):
    • 1st Year: Accrue up to 7 days (56 hours)
    • 2nd Year: Accrue up to 10 days (80 hours)
    • 5th Year and beyond: Accrue up to 15 days (120 hours)
  • Health Insurance:
    • Company pays up to $300/month toward employee’s health insurance
    • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage (eligible after first month)
  • Retirement:
    • 401(k) plan with up to 4% company match

Posted By:

First Responder Protective Services
4006 Belt Line Rd, Suite 138
Addison, TX 75001
Texas Department Of Public Safety Private Security Program License # C10520601


Equal Employment Opportunity

First Responder Protective Services is an Equal Employment Opportunity and affirmative action employer. We celebrate diversity and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability status, or any other applicable characteristics protected by law.

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About the Role

Andy Frain Services is on the lookout for a motivated and detail-oriented Event Operations Manager to play a key role in driving event operations across our premier Sports & Entertainment venues. You will primarily focus on Fair Park/State Fair of Texas.

In this dynamic role, you will partner directly with the Account Manager to oversee event day operations, lead the security team, and ensure exceptional safety and experiences for fans, promoters, sponsors, and vendors.

Work Schedule Note: Flexibility is essential as this position involves a dynamic, event-driven schedule, including evenings, weekends, and holidays based on the venue calendar.

Compensation & Benefits

  • Competitive Salary: Commensurate with experience
  • Time Off: Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance options
  • Retirement: 401(k) retirement savings plan
  • Career Advancement: Opportunities for leadership development and professional growth within a nationally recognized industry leader

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations & Venue Leadership

  • Act as the operational lead for smaller events and manage concurrent venue dates across Dallas.
  • Oversee event-day execution, ensuring that security requirements and client standards are met.
  • Lead staff sign-in/sign-out processes and manage accurate post-event payroll and billing.
  • Serve as the primary lead in the Account Manager's absence.

Staffing, Onboarding & Development

  • Assist in the onboarding, training, scheduling, and management of event-day staff and supervisors.
  • Conduct pre-event briefings for teams of varying sizes, from small groups to over 600 personnel.
  • Monitor monthly event metrics and assess staff performance indicators.
  • Coach and mentor supervisors and staff on personnel matters in accordance with company policy.

Logistics & Equipment Management

  • Oversee the storage, distribution, maintenance, and tracking of venue equipment.
  • Prepare operational materials and documentation for event-day supervisors.
  • Submit equipment and supply requests 45 days in advance of the operational needs.

Risk Management, Safety & Client Relations

  • Identify and address potential safety risks for guests and staff.
  • Regularly meet with venue clients to ensure security, emergency preparedness, and safety compliance.
  • Ensure compliance with Federal and State OSHA, fire, and safety regulations.

jobs.description:
Overview

Allied Universal®, North America’s leading security and facility services company, offers rewarding careers that provide you a sense of purpose. While working in a dynamic, welcoming, and collaborative workplace, you will be part of a team that contributes to a culture that positively impacts the communities and customers we serve.

Pay Rate

Job Description

As a Security Officer Part Time Driver Patrol Documentation in Dallas, TX, you will serve and safeguard clients in a range of industries such as Aero/Defense, and more. Join a leading team where flexibility meets opportunity. As a Part-Time Security Officer, you can build a schedule that works for you and explore new roles using our Claim a Shift platform.

Learn more: aus.com/earnmore. As a Patrol Unarmed Officer at an aerospace and defense location, you will conduct routine patrols, monitor access points, and maintain a visible presence to help deter security-related incidents. This driving position offers the opportunity to provide exceptional customer service, communicate professionally, and support a caring, reliable team that acts with integrity.

Position Type: Part Time

Pay Rate: $19.23 / Hour Job Schedule:

DayTimeSat07:00 AM - 07:00 PMSun07:00 AM - 07:00 PM What You'll Do:

Provide customer service to employees, visitors, and contractors by carrying out security-related procedures, site-specific policies, and when appropriate, emergency response activities at an aerospace and defense location.

Respond to incidents, alarms, access concerns, and critical situations in a calm, professional, problem-solving manner, following established reporting and escalation procedures.

Conduct regular and random unarmed patrols of facilities, operational areas, parking areas, and the perimeter to help deter unauthorized activity and identify unusual conditions.

Monitor access points and visitor activity, verify credentials as directed, and report access-control concerns to appropriate personnel.

Prepare clear, accurate activity and incident reports, and communicate relevant information to site leadership and Allied Universal management.

Minimum Requirements

Have at least 2 years of security-related experience.

Provide proof of a high school diploma or GED as required by the client.

A valid driver’s license is required in accordance with Allied Universal driver policy requirements.

Access control and badge experience is preferred.

A state, county, or city-issued security license is preferred.

Be at least 18 years of age for unarmed roles; 21+ years of age for armed roles.

Possess a high school diploma or equivalent.

As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a background investigation in accordance with all federal, state, and local laws.

Allied Universal will consider qualified applications with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable laws.

As a condition of employment, applicants will be subject to a drug screen to the extent permitted by law.

Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment.

A valid driver’s license will be required for driving positions only.

Why Join Us

Smart Tools: Access to our exclusive technology to view and claim additional shifts to earn more.

Career Growth: Get paid training and access to career growth opportunities.

Financial Benefits: Participate in our retirement savings plan to invest in your future.

Exclusive Perks: Enjoy discounts on top brands and services through our Perks Program.

Closing

Allied Universal® is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race/ethnicity, age, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, genetic information, disability, protected veteran status or relationship/association with a protected veteran, or any other basis or characteristic protected by law.

For more information: www.aus.com. If you have difficulty using the online system and require an alternate method to apply or require an accommodation, please contact our local Human Resources department. To find an office near you, please visit: www.aus.com/offices.

jobs.title: Security Manager
jobs.description:
It's fun to work in a company where people truly BELIEVE in what they're doing!
We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Direct responsibility for on-site security vendor performance interfacing with on-site security teams in multiple data centers across the US
  • Provide guidance on corporate physical security programs to staff, vendors, and clients identifying gaps and recommending corrective actions
  • Develop and maintain post orders and standard operating procedures (SOPs) to ensure execution and enforcement of business conduct and integrity standards, employee safety and security, security investigations, crisis response, business continuity and security and government partnerships
  • Regularly communicate updates to internal stakeholders, vendors, and clients regarding incidents, emerging risks, and other matters that may impact data center operations, employees, vendors or clients
  • Monitor customer requests and ensure appropriate and timely response to tickets or incidents.
  • Perform security and vulnerability assessments
  • Function as technical support for Security staff
  • Lead investigations, reporting, and after-action work in response to policy violations or criminal activities.
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics to determine security team effectiveness
  • Assist with security budget and contract management
  • Deliver training on security topics, assist in the coordination of security services to support planned and unplanned operations, and support incident investigation efforts
  • Travel approximately 10 percent of the time in order to perform the above responsibilities at the multiple data center locations nationally, on-call availability 24x7
  • Ability to make decisions and take responsibility for decisions effecting multiple sites within the data center fleet

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5 + years of site/campus security management experience
  • Planning, organizational, and motivational experience
  • Project and program implementation and management experience
  • Experience drafting SOPs in technical and non-technical formats
  • Experience reporting on physical security and site administrative KPIs
  • Experience presenting in formal and informal settings
  • Experience with safety and emergency procedure protocols and regulatory interfaces
  • Knowledge in physical security strategies, principles, standards, policies, and procedures
  • Experience as an administrator responsible for security technologies including Video Surveillance, Access Control, and Incident Management Systems, Security Operations Centers

jobs.title: Security Officers
jobs.description:
Security Officer


We help make your world a safer place.

Securitas is a global company that offers the most advanced and sustainable security solutions in the industry. We are located in 47 countries and have 355,000 employees worldwide and over 150,000 clients.

Securitas plays an essential role for our clients and in society. The Security Officer position helps maintain a safe and secure environment for our clients by actively monitoring the premises, including patrolling a variety of locations. They preserve order while enforcing regulations and directives for a client site pertaining to personnel, visitors, and the area. Frequently our Security Officers will provide customer service and information to a client’s employees and customers.

We are driven by a clear corporate culture and purpose, which helps us live according to our values of Integrity, Vigilance, and Helpfulness. These values are at the heart of our culture, help define who we are and guide our actions.

No experience necessary! If you have retail, food service or hospitality industry background you are a great fit for this role; if not, we will provide you with the training and everything you need for a great introduction to a career in the security industry.

Are you interested in being part of our Team?

· Apply quickly and efficiently online 

· Interview from the convenience of your own home

· Weekly pay 

· Competitive benefits 

· Flexible schedules 

With over 80 years of protecting the things that matter, we’ve seen more than most. That’s why Securitas is the partner of choice for companies and an employer of choice for candidates worldwide.

 See a different world.

Securitas is committed to diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging in the workplace.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other applicable legally protected characteristic.”

Security Guard / Securitas Security/ Hurst, Texas / TXDPS License # B03946


Securitas employees come from all walks of life, bringing with them a variety of distinctive skills and perspectives. United through our common purpose, we provide the security needed to safeguard our clients' assets and people. Our core values - Integrity, Vigilance and Helpfulness - are represented by the three red dots in the Securitas logo. If you live by these values, we’re looking for you to join the Securitas team.

Benefits include:
  • Retirement plan
  • Employer-provided medical and dental coverage
  • Company-paid life insurance
  • Voluntary life and disability insurance
  • Employee assistance plan
  • Securitas Saves discount program
  • Paid holidays
  • Paid time away from work

Additionally, some populations may have the availability of accessing earned wages on a daily basis, prior to payday. Restrictions and fees may apply.
Certain waiting periods may also apply. Paid time away from work may be available either through a combination of vacation and sick time or under a PTO policy, depending on local requirements. Benefits may be different for union members.

jobs.title: Security Guard
jobs.description: [Security Officer / Patrol] - Earn $20/hr (Unarmed) or $30/hr (Armed) / Flexible Scheduling / Rapid-Response Assignments / Nationwide Full-Time & Part-Time Openings - As a Security Guard Armed/Unarmed at Fast Guard Service, you will: Monitor and patrol designated areas to ensure the safety and security of the premises and its occupants; Enforce rules and regulations set by the company and respond promptly to any violations or disturbances; Perform regular security checks to identify and report any potential hazards or suspicious activities; Maintain accurate and detailed incident reports for any security-related incidents or emergencies; Assist with access control by verifying credentials and monitoring entry and exit of individuals and vehicles; Respond to alarms and emergency situations in a calm and efficient manner; Provide exceptional customer service to clients and visitors by addressing any questions or concerns in a professional manner...Hiring Immediately >>
